# TL — Tools Library

> A free, open-source collection of developer tools that run entirely in the
> user's browser. No file is ever uploaded, no account is required, and there is
> no paid tier. Site: https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/ — source:
> https://github.com/shailesh-04/tl (MIT licence).

Every tool is a self-contained static page. Input is parsed and processed with
JavaScript (and, for the video converter, FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly) in the
visitor's own browser, so spreadsheets, API payloads, photos, and video files
never leave their device. Results are copied to the clipboard or downloaded
locally.

## Converters

- [JSON Converter & Data Filter](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/json-converter/): Converts an array of JSON records to CSV, Excel XLSX, TSV, XML, or reshaped JSON. Supports selecting a nested record collection, picking and renaming fields, and stacking AND/OR filter rules before export.
- [XLSX to JSON Converter](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/to-json/): Parses .xlsx and .xls workbooks and emits JSON, using the first row of the chosen worksheet as the object keys.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/csv-to-json/): Turns CSV text or a .csv file into an array of JSON objects, honouring quoted fields and embedded commas.
- [Video Converter](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/video-converter/): Batch-converts MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, and AVI, and extracts GIF or MP3, using FFmpeg in WebAssembly. Results download individually or as a ZIP.
- [Image Optimizer](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/image-optimizer/): Compresses and resizes JPEG, PNG, and WebP images with an adjustable quality slider and a before/after comparison view.

## Developer utilities

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/json-formatter/): Beautifies or minifies JSON and reports syntax errors with the position at which parsing failed.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/base64-encoder-decoder/): Converts text to and from Base64 with correct UTF-8 handling for emoji and non-Latin scripts.
- [Regex Tester](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/regex-tester/): Tests JavaScript (ECMAScript) regular expressions with live match highlighting, colour-coded capture groups, flag toggles, and a cheat sheet.
- [UUID Generator](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/uuid-generator/): Produces cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers singly or in bulk, via the Web Crypto API.
- [Markdown Previewer](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/markdown-previewer/): Renders Markdown live in a split-pane editor, including tables and fenced code blocks.

## Index pages

- [Home](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/): Overview of the library, with the full tool list and FAQ.
- [All Tools dashboard](https://shailesh-04.github.io/tl/tools-hub/): Searchable index of every tool.
